image_description: A close-up photograph of two unripe figs hanging from a branch against a background of large green fig leaves. The fig on the left is darker, showing purple and brown hues, while the fig on the right is predominantly green with some purple shading. Both exhibit the characteristic pear-like shape tapering toward the stem. The skin appears smooth with a matte finish. No cut cross-sections are visible.
